text:
incident-bot: P1 detected — elevated inference errors (5xx) in us-west-prod. Pager fired to on-call. War room: https://zoom.redwood/warroom/1841234567. Start 2024-11-02T14:03Z. Severity: P1.

emma: I'm on it, joining war room now. I will own ops.

marcus: I'll take customer comms/statuspage drafts. @emma confirm impact and any immediate mitigations. :+1:

emma: Initial triage: errors hit /v1/chat and /v1/generate for hosted API endpoints in us-west. Error rate ~5% (spike since 14:02Z), throughput ~-60% for affected routes. No sign of data exfiltration. Observed KV-cache eviction / throttle spikes and increased GPU kernel queue time on us-west-gpu-1. Workaround: route traffic to us-east or fallback to model-small-quantized.

raj: Got paged, looking at logs. I see repeated `KVCacheThrottle` entries and OOM warnings on a subset of replicas on pool us-west-gpu-1. I'm going to soft-restart the worker group (rolling) and quiet health checks during restart.

emma: Do the rolling restarts. Before restarting, enable fallback routing policy for high-tier customers to us-east and enable cache bypass for critical requests.

marcus: Draft status page (will post to status.redwood if no objections):
```
Status: Investigating
Components affected: Hosted API (us-west) — /v1/chat, /v1/generate
Impact: Intermittent 5xx errors and increased latency for some customers in US-West. Some requests may fail or see degraded throughput.
What we're doing: On-call is investigating root cause (KV cache throttle + GPU queueing). Rolling restarts of affected worker pool in progress. Traffic routing fallbacks enabled to reduce customer impact.
Advice for customers: If possible, route requests to us-east or use the `model-small-quantized` fallback while we stabilize.
Estimated next update: 15 minutes.
```

emma: Looks good, add "No customer data exposure suspected" to reassure customers.

marcus: Added that line and will push to statuspage now unless objections.

ops-bot: War room recording started by emma — https://zoom.redwood/recording/1841234567

raj: Rolling restart started on us-west-gpu-1 pool (replica set A -> C). Restarting one node at a time, ~90s drain each. Monitoring error rate.

emma: After first node restarted, error rate dropped to ~1.2% but still above SLO. Keep restarts going and monitor KV cache metrics.

marcus: Status page updated to "Investigating" and published. Customer comm draft posted to #customers-digest for review.

emma: Thanks. If restarts don't reduce errors to <0.5% in next 10m, escalate to model routing fallback for all tiered traffic and open a hotfix for cache throttling.

raj: Noted. Continuing restarts and trace collection. I have a flamegraph and heap snapshots going to the war room drive.

marcus: I'll prepare a short customer-facing blurb for affected customers (DM list) and share in war room for signoff.

emma: Affirmative. Tag me for send.

incident-bot: Pager acknowledged by emma at 1841234575.

marcus: Quick checklist for comms we used: 1) Incident time & scope 2) Affected endpoints 3) Mitigation + workaround 4) Clear ETA for next update 5) Action for customers (fallback) 6) Reassurance re: data exposure. Saved as template `inc-ops/minimal-status-template`.

emma: Good template. Keep thread for updates.

marcus: Next update in ~8m or when we have error rate under control.

ops-bot: On-call handoff note: next on-call in 30m is @olivia — tagging for awareness.

emma: Copy. Continuing ops.
